sections.title: 阅读理解 A
sections.intro: Read the passage and choose the best answer for each question.

blocks.text: The Garden Club at Riverbend School began with a single raised bed behind the science building. At first, only six students met after class on Fridays. They planted tomatoes, beans, and sunflowers, and kept a notebook of what grew and what did not.
blocks.zh: 河湾学校的花园社团最初只是科学楼后面的一个种植箱。起初只有六名学生每周五放学后集合。他们种了番茄、豆子和向日葵，并记录下什么长得好、什么没长好。

blocks.text: The club's adviser, Ms. Chen, wanted the project to be more than a hobby. She asked students to test three kinds of soil and record how much water each bed received. The results were surprising: the bed with the least water produced the sweetest tomatoes. Students learned that more water does not always mean better growth.
blocks.zh: 社团指导老师陈女士希望这个项目不只是一个爱好。她让学生测试三种土壤，并记录每块地浇了多少水。结果令人惊讶：水最少的那块地结出的番茄最甜。学生们由此明白，水多并不一定意味着长得更好。

blocks.text: Last spring, the club opened a small market on the school playground. They sold vegetables and homemade seed packets, and used the money to buy tools for the school's science lab. The market also gave younger students a chance to ask questions about growing food.
blocks.zh: 去年春天，社团在学校操场办了一个小市集。他们出售蔬菜和自制种子包，用收入为学校科学实验室购买工具。市集也让低年级学生有机会询问关于种植食物的问题。

blocks.text: This year, the club plans to build a rain barrel and a compost bin. Ms. Chen says the goal is not to produce the biggest harvest, but to help students notice the connections between soil, water, food, and their own choices.
blocks.zh: 今年，社团计划建一个雨水桶和一个堆肥箱。陈女士说，目标不是收获最大，而是帮助学生发现土壤、水、食物和自己的选择之间的联系。

questions.stem: What did the students discover about watering the beds?

options.text: More water always makes tomatoes sweeter.
The bed with less water produced sweeter tomatoes.
Tomatoes grow best without any water.
Watering the beds made the soil worse.

evidence.quote: The results were surprising: the bed with the least water produced the sweetest tomatoes.
evidence.note: least water 与 sweetest tomatoes 直接对应 B。
evidence.translation: 结果令人惊讶：水最少的那块地结出的番茄最甜。

optionNotes.C: 原文没有说完全不浇水。
optionNotes.D: 原文没有说浇水会让土壤变差。

links.sourcePhrase: the bed with the least water produced the sweetest tomatoes

questions.takeaway: 比较级 least/sweetest 是最直接的定位词。

questions.stem: Why did the club open the market?

options.text: To sell gardening tools to students.
To buy seeds for the next spring.
To raise money for the science lab and share gardening knowledge.
To build a rain barrel and a compost bin.

evidence.quote: They sold vegetables and homemade seed packets, and used the money to buy tools for the school's science lab.
evidence.note: 卖菜和种子包筹钱，给科学实验室买工具。
evidence.translation: 他们出售蔬菜和自制种子包，用收入为学校科学实验室购买工具。

evidence.quote: The market also gave younger students a chance to ask questions about growing food.
evidence.note: 市集也让低年级学生来问种植问题，对应 share knowledge。

optionNotes.A: 市集卖的是蔬菜和种子包，不是工具。
optionNotes.B: 收入用于科学实验室工具，不是买种子。
optionNotes.D: 雨水桶和堆肥箱是今年的计划，不是市集目的。

links.optionPhrase: raise money for the science lab and share gardening knowledge
links.sourcePhrase: used the money to buy tools for the school's science lab ... ask questions about growing food
links.note: 筹钱买工具 + 让低年级学生提问 = C。

questions.takeaway: 题干问 purpose，答案要同时覆盖“筹钱”和“分享知识”两层。

vocab.context: a single raised bed behind the science building
vocab.example: The herbs grow in a raised bed.
vocab.examPoint: raised bed = 高出地面的种植箱；raise 的过去分词作定语。
vocab.exampleZh: 香草种在高出地面的种植箱里。

vocab.context: She asked students to test three kinds of soil
vocab.example: The soil here is dark and rich.
vocab.examPoint: soil = 土壤；test the soil 检测土壤。
vocab.exampleZh: 这里的土壤颜色深、养分足。

vocab.examPoint: homemade = 自制的；复合形容词。

vocab.example: They turn food waste into compost.
vocab.examPoint: compost = 堆肥；compost bin 堆肥箱。

vocab.example: The farmers expect a good harvest.
vocab.examPoint: harvest 可作名词“收成”，也可作动词“收割”；本文是名词。
garden club = 花园社团；club 可指社团。
seed packet = 种子包；packet 指小包装。
compost bin = 堆肥箱；compost 指堆肥。

vocab.example: The tools are for the science lab.
vocab.exampleZh: 这些工具是给科学实验室的。
vocab.examPoint: science lab = 科学实验室；lab 是 laboratory 的缩写。

vocab.context: the connections between soil, water, food, and their own choices
vocab.collocation: the connection between A and B
vocab.example: She explained the connection between diet and health.
vocab.examPoint: connect → connection；connections between A and B。
vocab.exampleZh: 她解释了饮食与健康之间的联系。

vocab.context: more water does not always mean better growth

complex.quote: Students learned that more water does not always mean better growth.
complex.main: Students learned that more water does not always mean better growth.
layers: that 引导宾语从句，作 learned 的宾语。
not always 表示“并不总是”，否定的是“水多=长得更好”的简单对应。
complex.translation: 学生们由此明白，水多并不一定意味着长得更好。

complex.quote: Ms. Chen says the goal is not to produce the biggest harvest, but to help students notice the connections between soil, water, food, and their own choices.
complex.main: Ms. Chen says the goal is not to produce the biggest harvest, but to help students notice the connections.
layers: not to produce ... but to help ... 是并列不定式结构，表示“不是……而是……”。
between soil, water, food, and their own choices 修饰 connections。
complex.translation: 陈女士说，目标不是收获最大，而是帮助学生发现土壤、水、食物和自己的选择之间的联系。

structure.overview: 总—分—总：社团成立 → 实验发现 → 市集影响 → 未来计划与理念。

parts.label: 起因
parts.main: 六名学生周五放学后种植并记录。

parts.label: 实验
parts.main: 水最少的番茄最甜，水多不一定更好。

parts.label: 影响
parts.main: 卖菜和种子包，为科学实验室买工具，让低年级学生提问。

parts.label: 理念
parts.main: 建雨水桶和堆肥箱，关注土壤、水、食物与选择之间的联系。

structure.logic: 时间线（起初 → 去年春天 → 今年）+ 由事件到理念。
structure.examFocus: 第 1 题考比较级细节；第 2 题考目的，需要同时覆盖筹钱和分享知识。

mainIdeaChain.label: 起因
mainIdeaChain.idea: 花园社团从一个小种植箱开始。

mainIdeaChain.label: 发现
mainIdeaChain.idea: 水少反而更甜，水多不一定更好。

mainIdeaChain.label: 影响
mainIdeaChain.idea: 市集筹钱买工具，也让低年级学生了解种植。

mainIdeaChain.label: 理念
mainIdeaChain.idea: 目标不是最大收获，而是理解土壤、水、食物与选择之间的联系。

mainIdea.statement: 校园花园社团通过种植、实验和市集，让学生理解土壤、水、食物与日常选择之间的联系。
mainIdea.purpose: 说明校园花园项目的教育价值，而不只是生产食物。
mainIdea.theme: 校园实践、食物教育与选择

examPoints.title: least / sweetest 比较级
examPoints.analysis: 题干问发现，原文用 least 与 sweetest 构成对比；答案 B 把比较级改写为 less / sweeter。

examPoints.title: used the money to ...
examPoints.analysis: 市集收入用于科学实验室工具，不是买种子或卖工具。

examPoints.title: not ... but ...
examPoints.analysis: 结尾用 not ... but ... 把重点从“最大收获”转到“理解联系”，是全文主旨。
